item.title: 12 killed, 16 injured as bus carrying oil and gas workers overturns in Iran
item.description: A serious bus accident occurred in Iran's western Ilam Province, claiming the lives of 12 individuals. The bus was carrying employees of a natural gas liquids company when it overturned on Saturday night. Six ambulances and rescue vehicles were deployed to provide medical assistance to the 16 injured passengers. Authorities warned that the death toll might increase due to some victims' critical conditions. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: Iran has 1,500-2,500 missiles despite US claims of ‘decimated’ arsenal: Report
item.description: Iran's missile arsenal is estimated to consist of between 1,500 and 2,500 missiles, showcasing a significant military capacity. Both US and Israeli evaluations highlight Iran's resurgence in missile capabilities, despite previous airstrikes targeting production sites. Enhanced military strategies and precise targeting have allowed Iran to improve its striking effectiveness. The secretive nature of Iran's stockpiles and numerous producers complicate estimates, underscoring the necessity for vigilance among American and allied forces. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
